name: CSharp 传输互通验证
command:
python - <<'PY'
import os, pathlib, shutil, subprocess, tempfile
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='relay-review-csharp-') as directory:
    temp=pathlib.Path(directory)
    files=['tests/fixtures/unity-bridge-client-host/BridgeClientHost.csproj','tests/fixtures/unity-bridge-client-host/Program.cs','unity/Assets/Editor/FigmaBridge/BridgeCommand.cs','unity/Assets/Editor/FigmaBridge/BridgeWebSocketTransport.cs']
    for name in files:
        dest=temp/name
        dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copy2(root/name,dest)
    host=temp/'tests/fixtures/unity-bridge-client-host'
    subprocess.run(['dotnet','build',str(host/'BridgeClientHost.csproj'),'--nologo','--verbosity','quiet'],check=True)
    env={**os.environ,'UNITY_BRIDGE_CLIENT_HOST':str(host/'bin/Debug/net8.0/BridgeClientHost.dll'),'UNITY_BRIDGE_CLIENT_RUNNER':'dotnet'}
    subprocess.run(['node','--test','tests/unity-outbound-client.test.mjs'],env=env,check=True)
PY
description: 在系统临时目录编译实际 C# 传输源码并运行与 Relay 的互通/断线重连测试
